title: 第10章 百花散
content_zh:
第10章百花散
“什么？”
楚梁这话一出口，不由得让众人都有些惊讶。
要知道，在这样妖魔横行的丛林之中，真元又得不到补充，是说不定会遇上什么危险的。一旦真的遭遇什么突发的危险状况，肯定是保存的修为越多，脱离危险的机会越大。
所以出于本心，他们肯定都不想在开路这件事上浪费真气。正因如此，方霆才提出三人轮换的公平方案。
在楚梁开口说有意见的一瞬间，他们都以为此人是要想办法推脱责任，或者将方霆和徐子晴也拉进来。
可万万想不到……眼前这个笑容和煦的少年，居然主动提出要独自承担开路的任务。
他也仅仅是神意境初期而已，这份担当实在令人意外。
“楚兄弟，这可不是开玩笑的。”林北第一个劝道：“而且这条路说不定要走上个把时辰，你如果耗尽了真气，对于我们后续采摘人面玉精花的行动也不利，还是咱们轮流开路吧。”
楚梁微笑道：“没关系的，我有把握。如果我的真气即将不足，我自然就会退下来轮换。我修为低微，能帮忙之处不多，这里便让我多出几分力吧。”
他的言辞恳切，神情真挚，说得众人都有些许动容。
“你若执意如此，那便先由你开路。天色将晚，我们须得尽快入山。”方霆转身道，顿了顿，又补充一句：“你谨记若是真气耗费过半，就及时轮换。若是等消耗光了再说，那可就有些晚了。”
“我晓得的。”楚梁颔首道。
小姑娘徐子晴看着楚梁，扁了扁嘴。
实际上徐子晴的灵宠白鸟不是兄长给的，而是师尊给的。王玄龄对她自幼便十分宠爱，所以徐子晴对于师尊的感情也很深。对那与王玄龄有仇的银剑峰，自然观感很差。
刚听说楚梁是银剑峰帝女凤的徒弟，她是有暗戳戳敌视的。让他上自己的白鸟时，心里还觉得有些气不过，故意坐在前面孤立他。
可是小姑娘心思何其柔软，这个时候突然看见楚梁主动替团队承担责任，分明就是为了和大家拉近关系嘛。她忽然觉得，自己刚刚孤立人家的行为真是太不好了。
而且这个楚梁师兄……
安安静静的，还很英俊，笑得也很好看……一看就是个好人嘛。
徐子晴扯了扯衣角，小跑几步蹭到楚梁跟前，掏出一个小瓶子道：“楚师兄，这里是三颗聚气丹，你留着用吧。”

能帮人快速补充真气的聚气丹，在这种时候当然是有大用的。只不过聚气丹的主要作用还是在服药之后修行增长修为，在这里没法跟进后续的修炼，单纯地补真气，难免有点浪费。
“徐师妹，这……”楚梁刚想婉拒，就见小姑娘睁着水汪汪的大眼睛看着自己，眼中满是歉疚。似乎自己不收，她就马上要哭了。
这倒让他有些云里雾里，便也只好收下道：“好吧，真是多谢你了。”
“嘻嘻，没事的，我还有很多呢。”徐子晴见他收下，这才甜甜一笑。
楚梁走上前去将飞剑化形，仗剑在手。对于玉剑峰众弟子的心路历程，他没工夫细想。他之所以主动开路，理由很简单。
开路的人能打妖怪。
“嘶嗐——”
莽莽苍山，密林中满是几丈高的古老树木，树冠、藤蔓虬结，遮天蔽日，完全透不过一丝一缕的阳光。
方霆手中拎着一件灯笼样的法器，散发出柔和的光芒笼罩着众人，同时为前方照亮。走在最前面的楚梁将神识全部铺开在身前几丈，小心警惕地走着每一步路。
神识中刚刚探查到一丝妖气，就听前方传来一声怪响。
缠在一棵粗壮古树上的条条藤蔓中，忽然有一条猛地弹起，仿佛青斑巨蟒！而藤蔓的尖端处，有一朵拳头大的红色花骨朵，颜色妖艳至极。
当藤蔓扑过来的刹那，那红色花骨朵也瞬间
这美丽的花瓣里面，居然藏着一张吃人的嘴！
“小心。”楚梁轻喝一声。
与此同时，上前一挺身，长剑带着三尺剑芒气势汹涌地捅进了花心，噗嗤——
长龙一般贯穿柔软的花心，便又立刻拔出，随着一进一出，还飞溅出滴滴带着异味的汁液。那红嫩的花瓣张开带着黑洞洞的缺口，就此软倒，久久不能闭合。
方才短短半个时辰之内，楚梁已经对付了四只像这样的花妖。这镇南域山果然是遍地妖魔，纵使是边缘的一处丛林，也是危机四伏。这些藤妖花妖的伪装肉眼完全无法分辨，若不是已经开启了神识的神意境修者，恐怕走不了几步就要尸骨无存。
“歇息一下吧。”身后的方霆出声道。
虽然只由楚梁一人出手开路，但后面众人的神识也是时刻铺开、警惕着四周的。即使真气和体力可以节省下来，长时间铺开神识，也还是会感觉到疲惫。
对于修者来说，精气神三者，缺一不可。

“你们先收回神识调息一下，这段时间我负责警戒。”众人在原地盘坐以后，方霆也展现了金丹境的担当，独自一人守护着四周。
林北凑上前来，问道：“楚兄弟，你还好吧？”
“我的状态还不错。”楚梁颔首道。
他说的是实话，因为有徐子晴的聚气丹相助，他的真气现在还保持着满状态。对于聚气丹，他也丝毫没有节约的心思……毕竟打一只灯笼怪也就赚回来了。
只要有白塔给予的奖励在，那自己打妖怪就永远是稳赚不赔的买卖。
这样想着，他又闭目内视，怀着一丝期待来到了白塔之内。
就见白塔的铁牢之内，有四间各自关着花朵状的金色虚影。楚梁上前，按下了“炼”字。
红芒一闪，楚梁伸手接住了飘出来的光华。只见掌心是一包油纸包好的东西，似乎是药粉。
接着便有心念一动。
【百花散】：
百花精华炼制的解毒药，一半内服一半外敷，可解百毒。使用百花散还会留下花香随身，前调茉莉香、中调玫瑰香、后调石楠花香，香气浓郁经久不散。
content_en:
Chapter 10 Hundred Flowers Scattered
"What?"
As soon as Chu Liang said these words, everyone couldn't help but be a little surprised.
You know, in such a jungle where demons are rampant, and the true energy cannot be replenished, you may encounter some danger. Once you encounter any sudden dangerous situation, the more cultivation you save, the greater your chance of escaping from danger.
So out of their true intentions, they certainly didn't want to waste their energy on opening a road. Because of this, Fang Ting proposed a fair plan of three-person rotation.
The moment Chu Liang opened his mouth to express his opinion, they all thought that this person was trying to find a way to shirk responsibility, or to involve Fang Ting and Xu Ziqing.
But he never expected...the young man with a warm smile in front of him actually offered to take on the task of opening the road alone.
He is only in the early stage of the divine realm, and this responsibility is really surprising.
"Brother Chu, this is no joke." Lin Bei was the first to advise: "And this road may take an hour. If you exhaust your true energy, it will be detrimental to our subsequent operations of picking human-faced jade essence flowers. Let's take turns to clear the way."
Chu Liang smiled and said: "It doesn't matter, I'm sure. If my true energy is about to be insufficient, I will naturally step down and take turns. My cultivation level is low and there is not much I can do to help, so let me put in a little more strength here."
His sincere words and sincere expression moved everyone a little.
"If you insist on doing this, then you will be the one to open the way first. It will be getting late, and we must enter the mountain as soon as possible." Fang Ting turned around, paused, and added: "Remember that if the energy is used up more than half, you must rotate in time. If you wait until it is used up, it will be too late."
"I know." Chu Liang nodded.
The little girl Xu Ziqing looked at Chu Liang and pursed her lips.
In fact, Xu Ziqing's spiritual pet white bird was not given by her brother, but by her master. Wang Xuanling has been very fond of her since she was a child, so Xu Ziqing also has deep feelings for her master. Naturally, I have a bad impression of Yinjianfeng, who has a grudge against Wang Xuanling.
I just heard that Chu Liang is the apprentice of Emperor Nv Feng of Yinjian Peak, and she is secretly hostile to her. When I asked him to get on my white bird, I still felt a little angry and deliberately sat in front to isolate him.
But the little girl was so soft-hearted. At this moment, she suddenly saw Chu Liang taking the initiative to take responsibility for the team. It was obviously to get closer to everyone. She suddenly felt that her behavior of isolating others just now was really bad.
And this Senior Brother Chu Liang...
He is quiet, handsome, and has a nice smile... He looks like a good person at first glance.
Xu Ziqing tugged at the corner of her clothes, ran a few steps to Chu Liang, took out a small bottle and said, "Senior Brother Chu, here are three Qi Gathering Pills. You can keep them for use."
The Qi Gathering Pill, which can help people quickly replenish their true energy, is of course very useful at times like this. However, the main function of the Qi Gathering Pill is to practice and increase your cultivation level after taking the medicine. There is no way to follow up on the follow-up practice here. Simply replenishing the Qi is inevitably a bit wasteful.
"Junior sister Xu, this..." Chu Liang was just about to decline when he saw the little girl looking at him with big watery eyes, full of guilt. It seemed that she was about to cry if she didn't accept it.
This made him a little confused, so he had to accept it and said: "Okay, thank you very much."
"Hehe, it's okay, I still have a lot more." Seeing him accept it, Xu Ziqing smiled sweetly.
Chu Liang stepped forward and transformed the flying sword into shape, holding the sword in his hand. He had no time to think carefully about the mental journey of the disciples of Jade Sword Peak. The reason why he took the initiative to open the way was very simple.
Those who open the way can defeat monsters.
"Hiss-"
The vast mountains and dense forests are filled with ancient trees several feet high. Their crowns and vines are knotted together, blocking out the sky and preventing even a single ray of sunlight from passing through.
Fang Ting was holding a lantern-like magic weapon in his hand, which emitted a soft light and enveloped everyone., while illuminating the front. Chu Liang, who was walking at the front, spread all his consciousness a few feet in front of him, taking every step carefully and vigilantly.
Just as he detected a trace of demonic energy in his consciousness, he heard a strange noise coming from the front.
Among the vines wrapped around a thick old tree, one suddenly jumped up like a giant blue-spotted python! At the tip of the vine, there is a fist-sized red flower, which is extremely colorful.
When the vines rushed over, the red flowers also instantly
There is actually a man-eating mouth hidden inside these beautiful petals!
"Be careful." Chu Liang shouted softly.
At the same time, he stepped forward and thrust his long sword into the heart of the flower fiercely with a three-foot sword glow. Poof——
It penetrated the soft heart of the flower like a long dragon, and then pulled it out immediately. As it went in and out, drops of juice with a peculiar smell splashed out. The tender red petals opened with dark gaps, then fell softly and could not be closed for a long time.
In just half an hour, Chu Liang had already dealt with four flower demons like this. The southern region of the town is indeed full of monsters, and even a jungle on the edge is full of dangers. The disguises of these vine demons and flower demons are completely indistinguishable to the naked eye. If it were not for the cultivators of the divine realm who have already activated their spiritual consciousness, they would probably be dead within a few steps.
"Take a rest." Fang Ting said from behind.
Although Chu Liang was the only one to open the way, the consciousness of everyone behind him was always open and alert to the surroundings. Even if the energy and physical strength can be saved, you will still feel tired if you spread your consciousness for a long time.
For practitioners, the three elements of essence, energy and spirit are indispensable.
"You first withdraw your consciousness and adjust your breathing. During this period, I will be responsible for keeping watch." After everyone sat cross-legged on the spot, Fang Ting also showed his responsibility in the Golden Core realm, guarding the surroundings alone.
Lin Bei came forward and asked, "Brother Chu, are you okay?"
"My condition is not bad." Chu Liang nodded.
He was telling the truth, because with the help of Xu Ziqing's Qi Gathering Pill, his Qi was still at full level. As for the Qi Gathering Pill, he had no intention of saving at all... After all, he could just make money by killing a lantern monster.
As long as there are rewards from the White Tower, killing monsters by yourself will always be a sure-fire business.
Thinking like this, he closed his eyes and looked inside again, arriving at the White Tower with a trace of expectation.
Within the iron prison of the White Tower, there were four rooms each containing flower-shaped golden shadows. Chu Liang stepped forward and pressed the word "Lian".
There was a flash of red light, and Chu Liang stretched out his hand to catch the floating light. In the palm of his hand was a packet of something wrapped in oil paper, which seemed to be medicinal powder.
Then there was a thought.
[Baihua Powder]:
An antidote made from the essence of flowers, half taken internally and half applied externally, can detoxify hundreds of poisons. Using Baihua Powder will leave a floral scent with you, with the top note of jasmine, the middle note of rose, and the back note of heather. The fragrance is rich and long-lasting.
